privacy.s1P1: This Privacy Policy explains how the Moba Universe website (the “Site”) processes user data when you visit informational materials and MOBA guides.
privacy.s1P2: By using the Site, you acknowledge that you have read this Policy. Analytical cookies require separate consent via the cookie banner.
privacy.s2P1: The Site is operated by the owner of the Moba Universe project. For data processing questions and cookie consent withdrawal, contact:
privacy.s2Li3: Contact: via available Site contact details
privacy.s3P1: The Site does not require registration and does not collect passport or payment data. We may process:
privacy.s3Li1: Technical browser data: IP address, User-Agent, language, screen size, visit time (for analytics)
privacy.s3Li2: Site activity data: page views, clicks, navigation (Yandex Metrika — only after consent)
privacy.s3Li3: Local preferences: interface language (lang) and theme (theme) in browser localStorage
privacy.s4Li1: Necessary preferences — language and theme. Required for the interface and not treated as analytics consent
privacy.s4Li2: Cookie consent record — your Accept / Reject choice
privacy.s4Li3: Yandex Metrika analytical cookies — only after you click Accept
privacy.s4P2: You may reject analytics. In that case the Yandex Metrika counter is not launched.
privacy.s5P1: After consent we load Yandex Metrika (counter 110819737) for traffic statistics, content improvement, and UX analysis. Features may include webvisor, click map, and bounce tracking. Processing is also subject to Yandex terms:
privacy.s6P1: Analytical cookies are enabled only after explicit consent. You can:
privacy.s6Li1: Accept analytics — Metrika will be loaded
privacy.s6Li3: Change your choice later via Cookie settings in the footer or on this page
privacy.s6P2: Withdrawing consent stops further Metrika launches on this device. Third-party cookies already set can be cleared in your browser settings.
privacy.s7P1: Necessary preferences are processed to provide Site features. Analytics is based on user consent. Purposes: interface operation, audience insights, and improving guides and Site structure. Processing follows applicable law, including personal data protection rules where relevant (e.g. Russian Federal Law No. 152-FZ for users in Russia).
privacy.s8P1: You may request information about processing, withdraw analytics consent, restrict cookies in your browser, and contact the operator using the details above.
privacy.s8P2: The Site is intended for informational materials. We do not sell personal data to third parties for marketing.
privacy.s9P1: We may update this Policy. The current version is always available at /privacy. The update date is shown at the top of this page.
